title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
hook_text: Rivian adds AI to VW deal
hook_before: Rivian is adding a new AI assistant to its five point eight billion dollar joint venture with Volkswagen.
script:
Five point eight billion dollars is the new bet.
This expansion integrates advanced software directly into their upcoming vehicle architectures.
The companies have not disclosed if the total investment value will increase following this update.
This partnership aims to combine Rivian's software platform with the scale of Volkswagen's manufacturing.
Engineers from both firms are now working to embed voice-activated AI features into new car models.
Would you trust an AI assistant to control your car's settings while you drive?
